items.question: What is Nowly?
items.answer: Nowly is a browser extension that automatically updates your Discord status (Rich Presence) with what you are watching on your favorite streaming platforms. It consists of a Chromium extension, a Windows native messaging host, and a website. The entire project is open source and free.

items.question: Is Nowly free?
items.answer: Yes, Nowly is completely free. The project is developed by two people in their spare time. If you wish to support the project, you can make a donation via Ko-fi, but this is entirely optional — all features are and will remain free.

items.question: How do I install Nowly?
items.answer:
Installation is a two-step process:
Step 1: install the extension from the Chrome Web Store.
Step 2: download and run the Windows installer (the native application that communicates with Discord).
Once both are installed, Nowly runs automatically in the background. No further configuration is needed.

items.question: Which platforms are supported?
items.answer:
Nowly currently supports YouTube, Twitch, Disney+, Apple TV+, and Prime Video.

New platforms are regularly added through extension updates. These presences are built by both the core team and community contributors. Anyone can propose or create a new presence — check the GitHub repository to get involved.

Head over to the library for the full list and the development status of each presence.

items.question: How does the Discord connection work?
items.answer: The native application communicates directly with the Discord client on your computer via a Windows named pipe (IPC). No data passes through our servers. Nowly simply sends your current activity information (title, platform, duration) to Discord, which displays it on your profile.

items.question: Is my data sent to your servers?
items.answer: Your Rich Presence activity, no. The extension detects content in your browser and passes it to the native app, which sends it directly to Discord via local communication — our servers are never involved. That said, if you post a review on a presence (Discord login required), your Discord ID, rating, and comment are stored server-side. Analytics are opt-in and disabled by default.

items.question: Why is my Discord status not updating?
items.answer:
Several possible reasons:
  • Is Discord running on your computer?
  • Is the Nowly native application installed and running?
  • Is the extension enabled in your browser?
  • Is the presence for your platform installed from the library?


You can also open the extension's side panel to view debug messages.

items.question: How do I uninstall Nowly?
items.answer: To uninstall the extension, right-click the Nowly icon in your browser and select 'Remove from Chrome'. To uninstall the native application, run the uninstaller program available in the installation folder or use the Windows Control Panel.

items.question: Is Nowly open source?
items.answer: Yes, the complete source code of Nowly is available on GitHub. You can browse the code, suggest improvements, report bugs, or contribute to the project's development.

sections.title: A community project

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro: Nowly is designed with privacy as a priority. Your Rich Presence activity is processed entirely locally on your machine — it never passes through our servers. Some optional features (reviews, analytics) involve server-side processing, described below.

sections.title: General Operation
sections.body: Nowly consists of three parts: a browser extension, a Windows native application, and a website (library). The extension detects media content in your browser and passes it to the native app, which sends it directly to the Discord client on your machine via a local Windows named pipe (IPC). This activity data never touches our servers.

sections.title: Data Processed Locally (Extension)
sections.body:
The browser extension stores the following data locally in chrome.storage.local — it never leaves your device:
  • Installed presences (metadata, signed bundles, activation state).
  • Current activity (content title, platform, duration, thumbnail).
  • A debug log (timestamps, actions, visited URLs).
  • Onboarding state and a local snapshot of your Discord profile (ID, username, avatar) used solely for UI display.
  • Display preferences and per-presence settings.
This data can be erased by uninstalling the extension or using the reset option in the extension settings.

sections.title: Data Processed Locally (Native Application)
sections.body: The Nowly native application writes a log file to %LOCALAPPDATA%\NowlyClient\nowly-host.log containing timestamps and activity information sent to Discord. This file is stored locally, can be deleted at any time, and is never sent to our servers.

sections.title: Server-Side Data — Authentication & Reviews
sections.body:
When you log in with Discord to post a review on a presence, the following data is processed and stored on our servers:
  • Discord ID (discordId), username, and avatar — retrieved via the Discord API (scope "identify").
  • Rating (1 to 5) and optional comment (up to 500 characters).
  • If you post anonymously, your Discord ID is replaced by an irreversible hash (HMAC-SHA256), making direct identification impossible.
You can delete your review at any time from the presence page — this permanently removes the rating and comment from our database.

sections.title: Server-Side Data — Analytics (Opt-In)
sections.body:
The extension offers, during installation, the option to enable anonymous analytics (disabled by default). If enabled, the following is collected:
  • An anonymous device ID (locally generated UUID, not linked to your identity).
  • Browser, OS, language, extension version, and native app version.
  • Installed presences and activity sessions (duration, platform).
This data is used solely to improve the service and measure presence popularity. You can withdraw consent at any time from the extension settings — all data associated with your device ID will then be deleted.

sections.title: Discord Communication
sections.body:
Nowly communicates with the Discord client via a local IPC interface. The following information may be transmitted to Discord solely for displaying your Rich Presence:
  • The platform name (e.g. YouTube).
  • The content title you are watching.
  • The channel or author name.
  • Playback state (playing / paused).
  • Duration and elapsed time.
This information is visible to anyone who can see your Discord profile. Nowly has no control over how Discord processes this data once received. Please refer to Discord's Privacy Policy for more details.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
sections.body:
Nowly uses the following third-party services:
  • Railway (United States) — website, API, and PostgreSQL database hosting. Railway Privacy Policy.
  • Cloudflare (United States) — static asset delivery (thumbnails, native app installer) via CDN.
  • Chrome Web Store / Google — browser extension distribution.
  • Ko-fi — optional donations. Nowly shares no personal data with Ko-fi.
  • Discord — OAuth authentication (scope "identify") and local Rich Presence display.
  • OpenAI — automatic changelog generation. Only PR titles and code diffs are sent — no user data.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body:
The Nowly website uses only strictly necessary cookies:
  • nowly_oauth_state: technical HttpOnly cookie, 10-minute lifetime, used for CSRF protection during Discord login.
  • locale: language preference cookie, not shared with third parties.
No tracking or advertising cookies are placed. See our Cookie Policy for full details.

sections.title: Image Proxy
sections.body: Nowly runs a server-side image proxy that fetches thumbnails from third-party platform CDNs (YouTube, Twitch, Netflix, etc.) for display in the UI. This proxy collects no personal data — it processes only public image URLs server-side, with no link to your identity.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Presence packages are cryptographically signed (ECDSA P-256) before distribution. The extension verifies the signature before installing or running any presence, ensuring only authorized code executes on your machine. Authentication tokens (JWT) are valid for 30 days and are delivered in a way that avoids server-side logging.

sections.title: Your Rights (GDPR)
sections.body:
Under the GDPR, you have the following rights:
  • Access: request what data we hold about you.
  • Deletion: delete your reviews directly from the UI; disable analytics from the extension settings to erase device data.
  • Objection: opt out of analytics at installation or disable them at any time.
  • Portability: upon request, your data can be provided in JSON format.
To exercise these rights, contact us via the GitHub repository or at the address listed in the Legal Notice.

sections.title: Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By downloading, installing, or using Nowly (the browser extension, native application, website, and any associated software), you unconditionally agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the software.

sections.title: Service Description
sections.body:
Nowly is a free, open-source tool that detects media content in your browser and automatically updates your Discord status (Rich Presence) via local communication with the Discord client. The service consists of:
  • A Chromium browser extension that detects and reports your activity.
  • A Windows native application that acts as a gateway to Discord.
  • A website (library) for discovering and installing presences.
  • A developer SDK and tooling for creating custom presences.

sections.title: Minimum Age
sections.body: The service is intended for users aged 13 or older. Using the review feature (Discord login) also requires compliance with Discord's own terms of service, including their minimum age requirements in your country. If you are under 15, you must have obtained consent from your legal guardian.

sections.title: License
sections.body: Nowly is distributed as open-source software. You are permitted to use, copy, modify, and redistribute it in accordance with the applicable license (available in the GitHub repository). This license does not apply to content from third-party platforms (YouTube, Twitch, etc.) that you choose to display via Nowly.

sections.title: Responsible Use
sections.body:
You agree to use Nowly in compliance with applicable laws and Discord's Terms of Service. You must not:
  • Use Nowly to display illegal, hateful, defamatory, or rights-infringing content.
  • Post illegal content or third-party personal data in reviews.
  • Attempt to bypass the security mechanisms of the extension or native application.
  • Distribute modified, forged, or unsigned presences through the official infrastructure.
  • Use Nowly in a way that violates the terms of Discord or any platform you access.
  • Send abusive automated requests to the API.

sections.title: Reviews & Comments
sections.body: The library allows you, after logging in with Discord, to rate a presence (1–5) and optionally post a comment, including anonymously. You are solely responsible for the content you post. You can delete your review at any time from the relevant presence page. Nowly reserves the right to remove any review that is manifestly illegal or violates these terms.

sections.body: The service is and will remain entirely free. Donations via Ko-fi are purely voluntary and grant no additional features or benefits. Payments are processed by Ko-fi under their own terms. Donations are non-refundable.

CookiesPage.title: Cookie Policy
CookiesPage.intro: This page describes the cookies and similar technologies used on nowly.me. Nowly does not place any tracking, profiling or advertising cookies.

sections.title: Strictly Necessary Cookies
sections.body:
These cookies are essential for the site to function and do not require your prior consent.

nowly_oauth_state
Purpose: CSRF protection during Discord login (OAuth 2.0).
Duration: 10 minutes maximum — automatically deleted after login.
Type: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax. Not accessible by JavaScript.

sections.title: Preference Cookies
sections.body:
locale
Purpose: remembers your chosen language (French, English, Spanish).
Duration: session or persistent depending on your browser.
Type: standard cookie, not HttpOnly. Contains no personal data and is not shared with third parties.

sections.title: Analytics Cookies
sections.body: Nowly does not use any third-party analytics cookies. Usage statistics (installs, sessions, presence popularity) are collected through the extension only with your explicit opt-in consent, without cookies and without any link to your web browsing.

sections.title: Advertising Cookies
sections.body: Nowly displays no advertising and places no advertising cookies. No third-party ad network is active on this site.

sections.title: Managing & Deleting Cookies
sections.body: You can modify your browser settings at any time to block or delete cookies. Deleting the locale cookie will reset the language to the automatically detected value. Deleting the nowly_oauth_state cookie before Discord login completes will cause the authentication to fail.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any question about this policy, contact us via the GitHub repository or at the address listed in the Legal Notice.
